cs_ending_renewal_line1: You plant the seed Ardvin gave you. Yggdrasil dies anyway — but not alone, and not without issue. The Nine Worlds become smaller, poorer and infinitely younger.
cs_ending_renewal_line2: Yggdrasil groans. Somewhere another border tears.
ending_renewal_desc: You plant the seed Ardvin gave you. Yggdrasil dies anyway — but not alone, and not without issue. The Nine Worlds become smaller, poorer and infinitely younger.
cs_ending_binding_line1: You bind the breach with all nine runes. The worlds remain as they were — including everything that was wrong with them. Grimnir laughs as they lead him away.
cs_ending_binding_line2: Yggdrasil groans. Somewhere another border tears.
ending_binding_desc: You bind the breach with all nine runes. The worlds remain as they were — including everything that was wrong with them. Grimnir laughs as they lead him away.
cs_ending_breach_line1: You agree with Grimnir. The end comes swiftly, tidily and without rancour. What comes after, nobody watches you do.
cs_ending_breach_line2: Yggdrasil groans. Somewhere another border tears.
ending_breach_desc: You agree with Grimnir. The end comes swiftly, tidily and without rancour. What comes after, nobody watches you do.
cs_ending_warden_line1: You take Hrafn's place and hold the borders as long as you can. It is no solution. It is a promise — and you keep it for forty years.
cs_ending_warden_line2: Yggdrasil groans. Somewhere another border tears.
ending_warden_desc: You take Hrafn's place and hold the borders as long as you can. It is no solution. It is a promise — and you keep it for forty years.
